recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If further review is desired, verify or clean up the externally maintained InventoryItem artifact in the OO incubator IG; no FHIR core source correction is warranted for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-45741 asked to correct InventoryItem Boundaries and Relationships because it indicated InventoryItem could be referenced from ServiceRequest. The Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to remove the Transport and ServiceRequest bullets rather than modify ServiceRequest to reference InventoryItem.
initial_application: Commit b45398f65eca20db749c7cc8dbbbb67ff57bc2a7, titled FHIR-45741, commented out the Transport and ServiceRequest list items in source/inventoryitem/inventoryitem-introduction.xml while InventoryItem was active in source/fhir.ini. Current ServiceRequest source still has no InventoryItem targetProfile.
additional_context: The current source/fhir.ini active resource list omits InventoryItem, and later history (3b38b80 plus 01706a9) removed OO inventory/supply/transport resources from active core build metadata and pointed module links to the OO incubator IG. Confluence minutes confirm the persuasive-with-modification decision, and no directly relevant Zulip disagreement was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with external-repo status. Editing the stale, out-of-build InventoryItem source solely to delete HTML comments would not change the current FHIR core specification, and the incorrect rendered bullets had already been removed before InventoryItem left core build scope.
